why: The record page is "Mostly" buildable (benchmark section 11). Issue 3087 (row bench-record-identity) gives `PageBar` an identity with a face and makes the property list edit in place. What stays missing after it: `EventList` (basalt-ui/cards, src/cards/event-list.tsx) groups by day only (`groupByDay`, internal, src/cards/event-list-model.ts), its actor is a string and it has no connector; `TabsTrigger` (basalt-ui/ui/tabs) has no count, so a tab bar inside the page cannot match PageBar's counted tabs (`PageTabBadge`, src/page/contract.ts, drawn by `TabBadge` in src/page/page-tabs.tsx); nothing draws a relationship card (a grep for "relationship" in src finds none).
what: An activity timeline with period groups, counted tabs on the tabs primitive, relationship cards, and the supplier reference page on them.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/ui/tabs.tsx (a count on a trigger, sharing PageBar's badge)
a new relationship card module under packages/basalt-ui/src/cards
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/page/{page-bar.tsx,facts.tsx} and the property list Issue 3087 shipped, beyond adopting it
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md, sections 2 and 11. Decided: (1) `EventList` gains period grouping beside day grouping: This week, Earlier this month, then month names, then years, relative to `useNow`; the bucketing is one exported pure function that bench-inbox-mail reuses for its day groups. (2) An entry can carry an `Avatar` actor (basalt-ui/ui/avatar) and a connector rail joins the entries of a group; a long body folds to a line and expands. (3) `TabsTrigger` takes a count and an attention tone through the same badge PageBar's tabs draw, so one look serves both. (4) A relationship card on basalt-ui/cards: a linked record with its face (`EntityTitle`, basalt-ui/ui/entity), a role or a strength, two or three facts and a link that opens the record surface; a section of them lays out on `CardGrid` (basalt-ui/page). (5) The supplier page (`/ref/suppliers/$id`) adopts all three: an activity tab on the period timeline, counted tabs, a related-records section of relationship cards, on the identity and editable properties 3087 shipped.
